games.pronounsDescription: Learn who performs the action: I, you, he… and write the translation.
games.pronounsNote: 12 questions per round. Context distinguishes singular, plural and gender when a word has several translations. Covers personal and polite forms; excludes neuter or impersonal uses such as “it”. Spanish regional forms “vos” and “ustedes” are accepted in the appropriate contexts.

bingo.title: Bingo
bingo.description: Listen and recognise numbers from 1 to 99. Complete your card!
Listen and recognise numbers from 1 to 99. Complete your card!
bingo.rules: Listen to numbers from 1 to 99, drawn automatically in random order without repeats. Cross off the numbers on your card. You can mark any number already called and check the called-number board.
bingo.wrong: This number has not been called yet.
bingo.audio: Speech is unavailable. You can play by reading the number.
bingo.hint: Listen and cross off your numbers. Check the board below if you missed one.
bingo.paused: Draw paused. You can still mark your numbers.
bingo.finished: All 99 numbers have been called. Check the board and finish marking your card.
bingo.boardHint: Called numbers are crossed off automatically. Select a crossed-off number to hear it again.
